table.retrieve:
SELECT  
	PatientCode=Patient.PatientCode,
	CustCode=Patient.CustCode,
	RegNo=Patient.RegNo,
	Name=Patient.Name,
	Date = Patient.OriginalDate,
	FName=Patient.FName,
	Gender=Patient.Gender,
	BirthDate=Patient.DOB,
	Age=LTRIM(RTRIM(STR( (DATEDIFF(dd, Patient.DOB, getdate()) / 365), 4, 0))) + ' Yrs ' +
		LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(DATEDIFF(mm, Patient.DOB, getdate()) % 12, 4, 0))) + ' Mon ' +
		LTRIM(RTRIM(STR((DATEDIFF(dd, Patient.DOB, getdate()) % 365 % 12), 4, 0))) + ' Days',
	Address1 = Patient.Address1,
	Address2 = Patient.Address2,
	CNIC = Patient.NationalIDCard,
	Mobile = Patient.MobileNo1,
	IssueDate = GETDATE()
FROM
	Patient
WHERE 
	Patient.PatientCode IN (:ai_code) AND
	Patient.Active = 'Y'
ORDER BY
	Name
